comparison.selection: Terminal command state and exact Undo/Redo selection; an extra post-command Cancel is replayed before history comparison.

scope_notes: Independent implementation from owned public command outputs; no proprietary source inspected.
First-radius Enter accepts the remembered radius. Second-radius and initial-angle Enter end without a placement or Undo record.

Point angles use resolved Circle axes; negative X takes atan(y/x)-pi, including quadrant II. Numeric zero Copy before a point pick does not change the rule. Tiny radial directions retain their angle; center and axial points accept zero.
Unchanged zero-angle placements record Undo. Native Undo after an empty exit removes probe setup instead, visibly leaving an empty document.
Repeated Copy retains originals and both radii in one Undo batch. Getter Copy saves immediately; Rigid resets and radius persists outside model history.
Application replay also uses the 29 preference/history steps hashed in docs/maelstrom-command-provenance.json.
Complete command invocations replay 33 non-Copy coordinate coil-angle cases from these captures; interactive tests cover all 44 recipes.
Alternative Circle construction modes, live deformed previews, continuous mouse-turn behavior and original native performance comparisons remain pending.
